name: Laser Metal Fabrication
old_description: Serving contractors, manufacturers, and engineering teams with high-precision cutting, fast turnaround, and custom fabrication solutions.
about:
Laser Metal Fabrication operates from Twin Falls, Idaho, in the Magic Valley region. The company was founded by Cort Johnson, who holds a bachelor's degree in Welding Fabrication Technology from Brigham Young University–Idaho and a master's in Project Management from Idaho State University. Johnson has lived in Twin Falls for nine years with his family, and his technical expertise and local roots form the basis of the business.

The shop provides precision laser cutting of sheet, plate, and tube — handling material from 24 gauge through 1-inch plate on sheets up to 6 by 12 feet, and tube up to 8 inches by 21 feet. CNC bending covers sheet metal up to 11 feet and tubing up to 24 feet with a 2.5 mm tolerance, supported by a 150-ton, 10-foot press brake. Welding capabilities include SMAW, MIG, TIG, and laser welding, complemented by fully integrated assembly services and 3D modeling and design. The facility runs documented production workflows to support scalable production for both industrial and ornamental applications.

Laser Metal Fabrication serves contractors, manufacturers, and engineering teams across industrial, commercial, and private projects. The company also produces custom home products such as window well covers and vent covers for residential and commercial clients. Its regional footprint spans the Intermountain West, with service areas including Twin Falls, Jerome, Buhl, Burley, and the broader Magic Valley, while nationwide shipping is available for production parts.

The company positions itself as a partner rather than a vendor, emphasizing documented processes for repeatability and quality control from one-off prototypes to full production runs. Its instant CAD estimator allows customers to upload DXF, DWG, STL, STEP, or IGES files for review-ready estimates, and the shop handles secondary services — forming, welding, and assembly — under one roof.
